# Armidale Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Armidale, Guyra, Uralla and the New England. Tell us your suburb, size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Armidale Skip Bins (armidaleskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Armidale, Armidale Regional Council (NSW), including Kellys Plains, Dangarsleigh, Invergowrie, Puddledock, Black Mountain, Saumarez Ponds, Arding, Guyra, Uralla, Kentucky, Wollomombi, Hillgrove, Ebor
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Armidale Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Armidale and nearby areas, including Kellys Plains, Dangarsleigh, Invergowrie, Puddledock, Black Mountain, Saumarez Ponds, Arding, Guyra, Uralla, Kentucky, Wollomombi, Hillgrove, Ebor. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Delivery to Guyra, Ebor, Wollomombi or Hillgrove, extra days and tight access can all affect the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road or footpath, Armidale Regional Council approval can include section 68 approval and section 138 Roads Act consent. Call council on 1300 136 833. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. More than 10 m² of bonded asbestos must be removed by a licensed removalist in NSW.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Armidale Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
